description: Subject: Sources Sought Notice - CSOSS/CSTOM/CSID  Notice ID: N6339427R0TBD-CSOSS  Notice Type: Sources Sought/Request for Information (Market Research) for Combat Systems Operational Sequencing System (CSOSS), Combat System Technical Operations Manual (CSTOM), and Combat System Interface Diagrams (CSID) Support Services   Contracting Office: Naval Surface Warfare Surface Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD)____________1.	General Information a. Contract Type: Cost-Plus-Fixed Fee (CPFF) term task order award from a SeaPort-NxG Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Contract (MAC), includes CPFF, cost only, Firm-Fixed Price (FFP), and Not Separately Priced (NSP) Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs) b. North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 541330 - Engineering Services c. (Annual) Small Business Size Standard: $25.5 Million d. Product Service Code (PSC): R425 - Support - Professional: Engineering/Technical e. Ordering Period: Five Year Ordering Period____________2. Introduction and Disclaimer: This is a Sources Sought Notice for market research purposes only.  NSWC PHD issues this Sources Sought Notice for informational and planning purposes only and does not constitute an Invitation for Bid (IFB), Request for Quote (RFQ), or Request for Proposal (RFP).  This Sources Sought Notice is not a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract.  No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated and/or incurred with providing information in response to this Sources Sought Notice or any follow-up information requests.  Responses to this Sources Sought Notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract.  This Sources Sought Notice is a means of conducting market research to identify interested, capable small business concerns and other industry sources for this requirement.  This Sources Sought Notice is focused on identifying capabilities in the marketplace and resources to support this requirement, as well as obtaining related technical information for the procurement of the requirement listed below.  The results of this market research will contribute to determining the feasibility of a small business set aside, as well as the method of procurement.  The applicable NAICS code assigned to this procurement is 541330 - Engineering Services with an annual small business size standard of $25.5 Million.  This potential requirement will be awarded as a single task order award.  The performance period will be for one base year with four option years.  It is a follow-on contract to current contract, Contract No. N0017819D7599: Task Order No. N6339422F3003.____________3. Description of Requirement NSWC PHD is seeking to identify potential sources capable of providing CSOSS/CSTOM/CSID support services.  This procurement provides engineering, technical, integration, maintenance, delivery, and crew orientation services for CSOSS/CSTOM/CSID. The Contractor will provide services necessary to support the CSOSS/CSTOM/CSID mission to include, but may not be limited to the following: Systems Engineering and Package Development, Life Cycle Maintenance (LCM), Technical Inquiry and Feedback Support, Configuration and Standards Management, Systems and Software Programming Support ____________4. Scope of Work: NSWC PHD is seeking to identify potential sources capable of providing CSOSS/CSTOM/CSID support services.  Interested parties are encouraged to review the draft Statement of Work (SOW) thoroughly.  Please reference the attached draft SOW that provides a detailed description of the required services.  ____________5. Requested Information: Interested parties shall submit a Company Information and Capability Statement (maximum of 10 pages) that summarizes and sufficiently addresses their ability to perform the requirements of the attached draft SOW.  The requested information shall address all of the following: a. Section 1: Company Information 1) Company Profile: Company Name, Corporate Address, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) (updated from Data Universal Number System (DUNS)), and Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) code. 2) Company Representative(s)/Point of Contact(s): Primary and secondary Company designated representative/point of contact names, job titles, phone numbers, and email addresses. 3) Business Size and Socioeconomic Status (under NAICS): Identification of business size and socioeconomic status under NAICS 541330 ($25.5 Million annual small business standard) as reflected in SAM.gov, including verification of SAM.gov registrations for one or more of the following: a) Small Business (SB) b)	Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) c) 8(a) Participant d) Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone) Small Business e) Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) f) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) g) Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) h) Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), or i) Large Business. b. Section 2: Capability Statement 1) Interested parties shall submit a (Technical) Capability Statement that provides a brief overview and sufficiently addresses their experience as stated in the SOW to demonstrate the Contractor s capability to fully perform the requirement. 2)  Includes the following as well: a) Management Capability: Describe your approach to managing a contract of this size and complexity, including your experience managing multi-disciplinary teams and subcontractors. b) Capacity: Demonstrate your capacity to meet the personnel requirements and other resource needs outlined in the SOW. c) Security Clearance: Confirm your ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearances for personnel. d) Accounting System: Provide a statement regarding the existence of a DCAA-approved accounting system for cost-type contracts. e) SBA Certifications (if applicable): List any approved SBA certifications.____________6.
